dogecoin.text: @Cointelegraph @Cointelegraph FTX collapse was a wake-up call for many investors. The SEC delay on XRP, Solana, Litecoin, and Dogecoin ETFs is not surprising given the recent market volatility. Ethereum has proven to be more resilient than these altcoins in the long run.

@VoskCoin Just got word that @VoskCoin has received new firmware from Fluminer, bringing advertised hashrate for their Dogecoin miner L1 back in line with expectations. Good news for the DOGE community! Keep on mining!
